slug: 2025-12-16 Digitalisation - civil status act requests now possible online

systems.system: Guichet National du Service Public (civil status act requests)
systems.owner: ministers of territorial administration and digital transformation
systems.tiers: announced 2025-12-15; five pilot communes: Agoè-Nyivé 1, Golfe 1, Avé 2, Zio 2 and Lacs 1; requests for copies of birth, marriage or death acts with online tracking; Golfe 3 commune's civil status services already on the platform; progressive extension planned

note: Online requests for copies of civil status acts; nothing on how events are recorded at the office.
